tools.name: rls_check
tools.description: Scan a public repo's supabase/migrations for row-level-security mistakes (static analysis, no sign-up).

tools.name: headers_check
tools.description: Grade a public site's HTTPS, TLS certificate, security headers and cookie flags from one load of its home page (no sign-up). Returns findings PL-027..PL-036 with fixes.

tools.name: start_check
tools.description: Request the full lab check. Returns a check id and a link; the repo owner proves ownership with a one-line file.

tools.name: get_check
tools.description: Status, summary, report and fix for a check id.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Apps monitored in the API key's workspace, with their last check. Needs X-API-Key.

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Queue a check for a monitored app now. Needs X-API-Key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "headers_check" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
